po_number.description: Purchase order number shared by all documents, labelled 'PO No', 'Purchase Order' or 'PO Number'

vendor_name.description: Legal name of the supplier, labelled 'Supplier', 'Vendor' or 'Sold By'

po_date.description: Date the purchase order was raised, labelled 'PO Date'

invoice_number.description: The supplier's invoice number, labelled 'Invoice No', 'Invoice #' or 'Bill No'

invoice_date.description: Date the invoice was issued, labelled 'Invoice Date', 'Date' or 'Dated'

grn_number.description: Goods receipt note number from the stores, labelled 'GRN No'

ordered_qty.description: Quantity ordered on the purchase order, labelled 'Ordered Qty' or 'Ordered'

received_qty.description: Total quantity received at the gate, labelled 'Total Received Qty'

po_value.description: Order value before tax from the PO register, labelled 'PO Value'

invoice_subtotal.description: Invoice amount before tax, labelled 'Sub Total', 'Subtotal' or 'Taxable Value'

invoice_total.description: Invoice amount payable including taxes, labelled 'Grand Total', 'Total Due' or 'Amount Payable'
